authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 6152 danta explicitly gives Khowar don tooth, plus widespread dand/dā̃t. The generic Khowar donor-category node found by search is not a competing lexical etymon. Non-Khowar dot/dad shapes are compared with the danta family while vowel and nasal-loss details remain qualified. Exact survey form don is preserved.
